user_prompt: Create a publication-quality French evidence-literacy schematic, horizontal 16:9, warm ivory background, clean vector, colorblind-safe teal blue orange charcoal, sans-serif, no logo, no watermark. Title exactly: Du résultat publié à la décision de RCP. Show a left-to-right chain of exactly five distinct connected stages: 1 Question — PICO + temps; 2 Validité — biais et données; 3 Effet — relatif, absolu, incertitude; 4 Applicabilité — population et contexte; 5 Décision — bénéfices, risques, préférences. Use one simple icon per stage and arrows only between adjacent stages. Under the chain, one orange caution line exactly: Une information manquante reste une incertitude explicite. Do not show a direct arrow from publication to prescription. No extra text, no duplicated labels, perfectly legible French.

iterations.prompt:
Create a high-quality scientific diagram with these requirements:

VISUAL QUALITY:
- Clean white or light background (no textures or gradients)
- High contrast for readability and printing
- Professional, publication-ready appearance
- Sharp, clear lines and text
- Adequate spacing between elements to prevent crowding

TYPOGRAPHY:
- Clear, readable sans-serif fonts (Arial, Helvetica style)
- Minimum 10pt font size for all labels
- Consistent font sizes throughout
- All text horizontal or clearly readable
- No overlapping text

SCIENTIFIC STANDARDS:
- Accurate representation of concepts
- Clear labels for all components
- Include scale bars, legends, or axes where appropriate
- Use standard scientific notation and symbols
- Include units where applicable

ACCESSIBILITY:
- Colorblind-friendly color palette (use Okabe-Ito colors if using color)
- High contrast between elements
- Redundant encoding (shapes + colors, not just colors)
- Works well in grayscale

LAYOUT:
- Logical flow (left-to-right or top-to-bottom)
- Clear visual hierarchy
- Balanced composition
- Appropriate use of whitespace
- No clutter or unnecessary decorative elements

IMPORTANT - NO FIGURE NUMBERS:
- Do NOT include "Figure 1:", "Fig. 1", or any figure numbering in the image
- Do NOT add captions or titles like "Figure: ..." at the top or bottom
- Figure numbers and captions are added separately in the document/LaTeX
- The diagram should contain only the visual content itself

iterations.critique:
SCORE: 6.8

STRENGTHS:
- Excellent visual iconography representing each methodological step accurately (PICO/clock, balance scale, bar chart with confidence intervals, population circles, decision tree with handshake).
- Perfect adherence to color palette (teal blue, orange, charcoal on warm ivory), title text, and bottom caution statement wording.

ISSUES:
- The stage labels ("Question — PICO + temps", "Validité — biais et données", etc.) are completely duplicated, appearing both above and below the icons, violating the "no duplicated labels" requirement.
- Text rendering artifact in the bottom-right label where "bénéfices" has a corrupted character ("bénéfic:s").

VERDICT: NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT

**Suggestions for Improvement:**
1. Remove the entire redundant row of text below the icons, keeping only the top labels above the icons to create a clean, uncluttered layout.
2. Fix the character artifact in "bénéfices" on the final stage text.
